text_en: Since many have undertaken to set down an orderly account of the events that have been fulfilled among us,
text_cn: 德敖斐罗钧座：关于在我们中间所完成的事迹，已有许多人，

text_en: just as they were handed on to us by those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word,
text_cn: 依照那些自始亲眼见过，并为真道服役的人所传给我们的，着手编成了记述，

text_en: I too decided, after investigating everything carefully from the very first, to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
text_cn: 我也从起头仔细访查了一切，遂立意按着次第给你写出来，

text_en: so that you may know the truth concerning the things about which you have been instructed.
text_cn: 为使你认清给你所讲授的道理，正确无误。

text_en: In the days of King Herod of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly order of Abijah. His wife was a descendant of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
text_cn: 在犹太王黑落德的时候，阿彼雅班中有一位司祭名叫匝加利亚，他的妻子是出于亚郎的后代，名叫依撒伯尔。

text_en: Both of them were righteous before God, living blamelessly according to all the commandments and regulations of the Lord.
text_cn: 二人在天主前是义人，都照上主的一切诫命和礼规行事，无可指摘。

text_en: But they had no children, because Elizabeth was barren, and both were getting on in years.
text_cn: 但是，他们没有孩子，因为依撒伯尔素不生育，两人又都上了年纪。

text_en: Once when he was serving as priest before God and his section was on duty,
text_cn: 正逢匝加利亚轮着他的班次，在天主前尽司祭的职务时，

text_en: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to enter the sanctuary of the Lord and offer incense.
text_cn: 按着司祭的常例，他抽中了签，得进上主的圣所献香。

text_en: Now at the time of the incense offering, the whole assembly of the people was praying outside.
text_cn: 献香的时候，众百姓都在外面祈祷。

text_en: Then there appeared to him an angel of the Lord, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
text_cn: 有一位上主的天使站在香坛右边显现给他。

text_en: When Zechariah saw him, he was terrified; and fear overwhelmed him.
text_cn: 匝加利亚一见，惊惶失措，害怕起来；

text_en: But the angel said to him, “Do not be afraid, Zechariah, for your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you will name him John.
text_cn: 但天使向他说：“匝加利亚，不要害怕！因为你的祈祷已蒙应允，你的妻子依撒伯尔要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫若翰。

text_en: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth,
text_cn: 你必要喜乐欢跃，许多人也要因他的诞生而喜乐，

text_en: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He must never drink wine or strong drink; even before his birth he will be filled with the Holy Spirit.
text_cn: 因为他在上主面前将是伟大的，淡酒浓酒他都不喝，而且，他还在母胎中就要充满圣神；

text_en: He will turn many of the people of Israel to the Lord their God.
text_cn: 他要使许多以色列子民转向上主，他们的天主；

text_en: With the spirit and power of Elijah he will go before him, to turn the hearts of parents to their children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord. ”
text_cn: 他要以厄里亚的精神和能力，在他前面先行，使为父的心转向儿子，使悖(bèi)逆者转向义人的心意，并为上主准备一个善良的百姓。”

text_en: Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know that this is so? For I am an old man, and my wife is getting on in years. ”
text_cn: 匝加利亚遂向天使说：“我凭着什么能知道这事呢？因为我已经老了，我的妻子也上了年纪。”

text_en: The angel replied, “I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
text_cn: 天使回答说：“我是站在天主面前的加俾额尔，奉命来向你说话，报给你这个喜讯。

text_en: But now, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their time, you will become mute, unable to speak, until the day these things occur. ”
text_cn: 看，你必成为哑巴，不能说话，直到这些事成就的那一天，因为你没有相信我的话；但我的话届时必要应验。”

text_en: Meanwhile the people were waiting for Zechariah, and wondered at his delay in the sanctuary.
text_cn: 百姓等候匝加利亚，都奇怪他滞留在圣所内。

text_en: When he did come out, he could not speak to them, and they realized that he had seen a vision in the sanctuary. He kept motioning to them and remained unable to speak.
text_cn: 及至他出来后，竟不能与他们讲话，他们这才知道他在圣所中见了异象；他已成了哑巴，只给他们打手势。

text_en: When his time of service was ended, he went to his home.
text_cn: 他供职的日期一满，就回了家。

text_en: After those days his wife Elizabeth conceived, and for five months she remained in seclusion. She said,
text_cn: 几天以后，他的妻子依撒伯尔受了孕，自己躲藏了五个月，说：

text_en: “This is what the Lord has done for me when he looked favorably on me and took away the disgrace I have endured among my people. ”
text_cn: “上主在眷顾的日子，这样待了我，除去了我在人间的耻辱。”

text_en: In the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent by God to a town in Galilee called Nazareth,
text_cn: 到了第六个月，天使加俾额尔奉天主差遣，往加里肋亚一座名叫纳匝肋的城去，

text_en: to a virgin engaged to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin’s name was Mary.
text_cn: 到一位童贞女那里，她已与达味家族中的一个名叫若瑟的男子订了婚，童贞女的名字叫玛利亚。

text_en: And he came to her and said, “Greetings, favored one! The Lord is with you. ”
text_cn: 天使进去向她说：“万福！充满恩宠者，上主与你同在！”【在女人中你是蒙祝福的。】

text_en: But she was much perplexed by his words and pondered what sort of greeting this might be.
text_cn: 她却因这话惊惶不安，便思虑这样的请安有什么意思。

text_en: The angel said to her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
text_cn: 天使对她说：“玛利亚，不要害怕，因为你在天主前获得了宠幸。

text_en: And now, you will conceive in your womb and bear a son, and you will name him Jesus.
text_cn: 看，你将怀孕生子，并要给他起名叫耶稣。

text_en: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High, and the Lord God will give to him the throne of his ancestor David.
text_cn: 他将是伟大的，并被称为至高者的儿子，上主天主要把他祖先达味的御座赐给他。

text_en: He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and of his kingdom there will be no end. ”
text_cn: 他要为王统治雅各伯家，直到永远；他的王权没有终结。”

text_en: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, since I am a virgin? ”
text_cn: 玛利亚便向天使说：“这事怎能成就？因为我不认识男人。”

text_en: The angel said to her, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; therefore the child to be born will be holy; he will be called Son of God.
text_cn: 天使答复她说：“圣神要临于你，至高者的能力要庇荫你，因此，那要诞生的圣者，将称为天主的儿子。

text_en: And now, your relative Elizabeth in her old age has also conceived a son; and this is the sixth month for her who was said to be barren.
text_cn: 且看，你的亲戚依撒伯尔，她虽在老年，却怀了男胎，本月已六个月了，她原是素称不生育的，

text_en: For nothing will be impossible with God. ”
text_cn: 因为在天主前没有不能的事。”

text_en: Then Mary said, “Here am I, the servant of the Lord; let it be with me according to your word. ” Then the angel departed from her.
text_cn: 玛利亚说：“看！上主的婢女，愿照你的话成就于我罢！”天使便离开她去了。

text_en: In those days Mary set out and went with haste to a Judean town in the hill country,
text_cn: 玛利亚就在那几日起身，急速往山区去，到了犹大的一座城。

text_en: where she entered the house of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.
text_cn: 她进了匝加利亚的家，就给依撒伯尔请安。

text_en: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the child leaped in her womb. And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit
text_cn: 依撒伯尔一听到玛利亚请安，胎儿就在她的腹中欢跃。依撒伯尔遂充满了圣神，

text_en: and exclaimed with a loud cry, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb.
text_cn: 大声呼喊说：“在女人中你是蒙祝福的，你的胎儿也是蒙祝福的。

text_en: And why has this happened to me, that the mother of my Lord comes to me?
text_cn: 吾主的母亲驾临我这里，这是我哪里得来的呢？

text_en: For as soon as I heard the sound of your greeting, the child in my womb leaped for joy.
text_cn: 看，你请安的声音一入我耳，胎儿就在我腹中欢喜踊跃。

text_en: And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord. ”
text_cn: 那信了由上主传于她的话必要完成的，是有福的。”

text_en: And Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord,
text_cn: 玛利亚遂说： “我的灵魂颂扬上主，

text_en: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior,
text_cn: 我的心神欢跃于天主，我的救主，

text_en: for he has looked with favor on the lowliness of his servant. Surely, from now on all generations will call me blessed;
text_cn: 因为他垂顾了他婢女的卑微， 今后万世万代都要称我有福；

text_en: for the Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy is his name.
text_cn: 因全能者在我身上行了大事， 他的名字是圣的，

text_en: His mercy is for those who fear him from generation to generation.
text_cn: 他的仁慈世世代代于无穷世， 赐与敬畏他的人。

text_en: He has shown strength with his arm; he has scattered the proud in the thoughts of their hearts.
text_cn: 他伸出了手臂施展大能， 驱散那些心高气傲的人。

text_en: He has brought down the powerful from their thrones, and lifted up the lowly;
text_cn: 他从高座上推下权势者， 却举扬了卑微贫困的人。

text_en: he has filled the hungry with good things, and sent the rich away empty.
text_cn: 他曾使饥饿者饱飨美物， 反使那富有者空手而去。

text_en: He has helped his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy,
text_cn: 他曾回忆起自己的仁慈， 扶助了他的仆人以色列，

text_en: according to the promise he made to our ancestors, to Abraham and to his descendants forever. ”
text_cn: 正如他向我们的祖先所说过的恩许， 施恩于亚巴郎和他的子孙，直到永远。”

text_en: And Mary remained with her about three months and then returned to her home.
text_cn: 玛利亚同依撒伯尔住了三个月左右，就回本家去了。

text_en: Now the time came for Elizabeth to give birth, and she bore a son.
text_cn: 依撒伯尔满了产期，就生了一个儿子。

text_en: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown his great mercy to her, and they rejoiced with her.
text_cn: 她的邻居和亲戚听说上主向她大施仁慈，都和她一同欢乐。

text_en: On the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him Zechariah after his father.
text_cn: 到了第八天，人们来给这孩子行割损礼，并愿意照他父亲的名字叫他匝加利亚。

text_en: But his mother said, “No; he is to be called John. ”
text_cn: 他的母亲说：“不，要叫他若翰。”

text_en: They said to her, “None of your relatives has this name. ”
text_cn: 他们就向她说：“在你亲族中没有叫这个名字的。”

text_en: Then they began motioning to his father to find out what name he wanted to give him.
text_cn: 他们便给他的父亲打手势，看他愿意叫他什么。

text_en: He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, “His name is John. ” And all of them were amazed.
text_cn: 他要了一块小板，写道：“若翰是他的名字。”众人都惊讶起来。

text_en: Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue freed, and he began to speak, praising God.
text_cn: 匝加利亚的口和舌头立时开了，遂开口赞美天主。

text_en: Fear came over all their neighbors, and all these things were talked about throughout the entire hill country of Judea.
text_cn: 于是，所有的邻居都满怀怕情；这一切事就传遍了全犹大山区，

text_en: All who heard them pondered them and said, “What then will this child become? ” For, indeed, the hand of the Lord was with him.
text_cn: 凡听见的人都将这事存在心中，说：“这孩子将成为什么人物啊？”因为上主的手与他同在。

text_en: Then his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke this prophecy:
text_cn: 他的父亲匝加利亚充满了圣神，遂预言说：

text_en: “Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, for he has looked favorably on his people and redeemed them.
text_cn: “上主，以色列的天主应受赞美， 因他眷顾救赎了自己的民族，

text_en: He has raised up a mighty savior for us in the house of his servant David,
text_cn: 并在自己的仆人达味家中， 为我们兴起了大能的救主，

text_en: as he spoke through the mouth of his holy prophets from of old,
text_cn: 正如他藉历代诸圣先知的口所说过的，

text_en: that we would be saved from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us.
text_cn: 拯救我们脱离敌人和仇恨我们者的手。

text_en: Thus he has shown the mercy promised to our ancestors, and has remembered his holy covenant,
text_cn: 他向我们的祖先施行仁慈， 记忆起他自己的神圣盟约，

text_en: the oath that he swore to our ancestor Abraham, to grant us
text_cn: 就是他向我们的祖宗亚巴郎所宣述的誓词，

text_en: that we, being rescued from the hands of our enemies, might serve him without fear,
text_cn: 恩赐我们从敌人手中被救出以后，无恐无惧，

text_en: in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.
text_cn: 一生一世在他面前， 以圣善和正义事奉他。

text_en: And you, child, will be called the prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the Lord to prepare his ways,
text_cn: 至于你，小孩，你要称为至高者的先知， 因你要走在上主前面，为他预备道路，

text_en: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the forgiveness of their sins.
text_cn: 为使他的百姓认识救恩， 以获得他们罪恶的宽宥：

text_en: By the tender mercy of our God, the dawn from on high will break upon us,
text_cn: 这是出于我们天主的慈怀， 使旭日由高天向我们照耀，

text_en: to give light to those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace. ”
text_cn: 为光照那坐在黑暗和死影中的人， 并引我们的脚步，走向和平的道路。”

text_en: The child grew and became strong in spirit, and he was in the wilderness until the day he appeared publicly to Israel.
text_cn: 这小孩渐渐长大，心神坚强。他住在荒野中，直到他在以色列人前出现的日期。
